title: School of Engineering bachelor rules
notes: Selected major-admission and bachelor-completion policies. Department-specific rules can be stricter. Upper-division credit totals are program-specific; A&S rules do not apply.

rules.label: Major-status degree-applicable credit
rules.statement: Complete at least 26 credits applicable to the intended degree.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Technical admission coursework
rules.statement: The page states at least 18 first-year technical credits and separately completion of the 19–25 technical credits in the first-year curriculum. Technical GPA is at least 2.5 and each technical grade at least C-minus; verify the applicable program threshold.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Admission GPA
rules.statement: Meet at least a 2.30 GPA across coursework presented for major admission, plus the separate technical-course GPA rule. Programs can be stricter.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Admission writing
rules.statement: Complete ENGL 1110 or its accepted equivalent. Do not infer legacy course equivalences from their labels.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Engineering GPA
rules.statement: Have at least a 2.0 GPA on UNM work counted toward the degree and at least a 2.0 GPA on all UNM work.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Required-course grades
rules.statement: Unless a stricter rule applies, required curriculum courses need at least C-minus. Gen Ed courses need at least C. This is a catalog eligibility rule, independent of CEDAR’s analytical DFW definition.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Required-course attempts
rules.statement: Complete required graduation coursework within three attempts, including external courses. The source counts letter grades, W, CR, NC, I and audit as attempts.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Low-grade credit restriction
rules.statement: Students with 30 or more credits of D-plus, D, D-minus, F or NC cannot graduate in Engineering, except work removed through the applicable academic-renewal or repeat policy.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Physical education activity
rules.statement: Physical education activity courses do not count toward Engineering bachelor requirements.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Introductory Studies
rules.statement: Introductory Studies courses do not count toward Engineering bachelor requirements.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Gen Ed course restrictions
rules.statement: Complete University Gen Ed using any specific courses required by the Engineering program/accreditation curriculum.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

rules.label: Engineering degree application
rules.statement: File the degree application with the department during the second semester of junior year and no later than completing 100 degree-acceptable credits.
rules.applies_when: All students in this rule set scope.

attention.statement: The same school page uses 18 technical credits and 19–25 first-year technical credits. Preserve both statements and require program-specific clarification before evaluating admission.
